assumptions.claim: squeezing is stable and glitch-free when observed by downstream logic via squeezing_o
assumptions.cond: when squeezing_o is used as a state indicator/handshake
assumptions.risk: glitches on squeezing could cause false state transitions on squeezing_o, potentially enabling premature output or corrupt digest data

uncertain_points.claim: continuous assignment of squeezing_o from squeezing may produce glitches if squeezing is not a registered signal, leading to invalid handshake edges for downstream consumers
uncertain_points.risk: downstream logic could sample a momentary incorrect value, possibly causing unauthorized output enable or data corruption in the context of SHA-3 squeezing phase
